description: NaSr₂O₆I is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent IO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-25°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.30 Å. Sr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.86 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three equivalent Sr, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.88 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.88 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three equivalent Sr, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.88 Å. I is bonded to six O atoms to form IO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-25°.
